Overview of Canton of Ticino Region (Ticino)

Canton of Ticino Region (Ticino) is located in the Canton of Ticino region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Bellinzona. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Lugano Lakefront, Monte Brè & Morcote, Locarno Piazza Grande & Valle Verzasca, Bellinzona Three Castles (UNESCO), Ascona lakeside promenade.

RegionCanton of Ticino
Capital cityBellinzona
Cities & municipalities22
Primary transport hubBellinzona Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Canton of Ticino Region

Gotthard Base Tunnel connects Zurich to Bellinzona, Locarno and Lugano in under 2 hours. Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Canton of Ticino

When visiting cities across Canton of Ticino, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Polenta braised over wood fire
  • Risotto al Merlot del Ticino
  • Luganighe sausage
  • Grotto chestnut specialties

Best time to visit Canton of Ticino

Best time to visit Canton of Ticino: Apr–Oct.
